subject: Procurement kickoff: DPA, SOC 2 snapshot & updated subprocessor matrix
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@cloudsparc.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, KarThik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Procurement kickoff: DPA, SOC 2 snapshot & updated subprocessor matrix

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking time today. As we kick off procurement for the CloudSparc engagement I wanted to consolidate the items our Legal/Finance teams need to finish vendor activation and route the PO: 

Requested by Redwood procurement (high priority):
- Executed (or redline-able) DPA — we can accept a vendor DPA or sign our standard (attached)
- Recent SOC 2 report / auditor snapshot (PDF) and the report period
- Current subprocessor matrix (spreadsheet) showing vendor, service, and location
- Purchase Order template or a clear remit/PO instructions for your AR team

If possible could you send the documents by EOB Tue 11/10? Our Finance team needs the SOC 2 snapshot to complete the risk review.

For context I'm looping Monica (Finance) to confirm PO routing and KarThik (Security) for any technical questions about subprocessors.

Happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Thanks —
Rafael Mendes
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v2.pdf
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@cloudsparc.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudsparc.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: DPA, SOC 2 snapshot & updated subprocessor matrix

Rafael —

Thanks for the clear list. Attaching the files you requested: SOC2_Report_Q3_2026.pdf (snapshot & auditor statement), subprocessor_matrix_2026-11.csv, and our PO template. We typically sign vendor DPAs and have included our standard DPA for reference; happy to review your version as well.

Notes:
- SOC 2 report covers Jan–Sep 2026 (Type II) — auditor: Brightline LLP
- Subprocessors: we added two new vendors in October; see rows 22–23 for hosting/CDN details and locations
- If Redwood needs encryption-specific attestations, let me know and I can pull the tech addendum

We can get an executed DPA on 11/17 if your legal team is able to review this week.

Best,
Elena Morris
Head of Procurement
CloudSparc Inc.
elena.morris@cloudsparc.com
Attachment(s): SOC2_Report_Q3_2026.pdf; subprocessor_matrix_2026-11.csv; CloudSparc_PO_Template.docx

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: DPA, SOC 2 snapshot & updated subprocessor matrix

Elena — really appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few quick items from our side: 

1) Monica — can you confirm Redwood's PO acceptance terms below and whether we require a specific remittance address populated on the PO?
2) KarThik — K1 and K2 subprocessors look fine but could you flag any that require additional security controls? (See subprocessor rows 22–23 called out by Elena)
3) Elena — our Legal prefers the vendor to sign Redwood's standard DPA when possible; I've attached Redwood_DPA_v2.pdf for comparison. If you sign yours instead, please highlight any data residency or subprocessor clauses that are non-standard.

If we can get a confirmed PO template and an ETA for an executed DPA, we'll start internal provisioning and set the go-live target for 12/01.

Thanks —
Rafael

Thanks, all — quick update from Finance: 

- PO routing: we can accept the attached CloudSparc_PO_Template.docx but please confirm the AP remit address and billing email; otherwise we'll route to the default accounts-payable@cloudsparc.com.
- Payment terms: Redwood standard is Net 45; if you need Net 30 we can review but will need approval from Treasury (let us know now).
- DPA: Legal is already comparing the two DPAs. If CloudSparc signs Redwood_DPA_v2 we can proceed faster. Otherwise please send redlines via DocuSign link and we'll triage.

Action items:
- Elena: confirm AP remit address + billing contact and confirm whether CloudSparc will sign Redwood's DPA or provide redlines (ETA 11/17).
- KarThik: please flag any subprocessor rows that need additional compliance attestations by EOD 11/11.

I'll create the internal PO record as soon as remit info is confirmed.

Regards,
